supported_workflows: Contract understanding and clause retrieval (NDAs, affiliate agreements, M&A agreements, privacy policies)
Legal-document question answering over unstructured contract text
Benchmarking legal retrieval and natural-language inference on contracts
supported_questions: Does this NDA grant the receiving party rights to confidential information?
What is the expiration date of the contract?
What is the type of consideration in this acquisition agreement?
Who can see information about tasks I hire workers for under Fiverr's privacy policy?

overlap_with.nature: Both are legal retrieval/QA datasets, but cover disjoint sub-fields: common-law contracts/regulatory privacy vs. Australian criminal procedure
Insurance regulation is adjacent, but no overlap in source documents or tasks

weak_content: Some contracts are simple templates with limited clause variability; retrieval value is high but generalisation to bespoke commercial contracts may be limited
primary_recommendation: Primary source for general commercial contract RAG and legal NLI/retrieval evaluation within the legal domain.
